notes: All coordinates are ORIGINAL pixels of photos/p29_ddf5dc.jpg (2500 x 1875, near-nadir drone, winter: most deciduous trees bare) unless an element names another image; "also" boxes in the ground photos are coarse (identification only).

Orientation in p29 (not compass): street + gated entrance bottom-left; driveway up the left edge; front porch faces down-left onto the lower front lawn; pool deck NE of the house; terraces rising east: patio -> stairs -> gravel path / play area / garden; synthetic lawn bottom-right below the orchard terrace.

Scale: ~28-30 px/m on the ground (solar modules on the roof ~30 px per 1.0 m short side; pool 420 x 202 px reads ~15 x 7 m at 28 px/m; the lot (1.03 acre) fits x 0-2340, y 130-1670 at ~29.5 px/m). Use the registered camera for metres.

Perspective: tall things lean AWAY from the image centre (~1250, 937): chimney caps, the arbor roof, the play structure, fence tops and tree crowns are displaced outward from their bases; trunk points are at the base where the trunk shadow starts, crowns where the foliage is.
Sun: shadows fall toward +y (down the image); the walls running along x cast dark bands south of them, the house shades its front (south) side, so the front beds / porch are in shadow.

Materials: driveway = tumbled pavers; every walk / patio = bluestone flagstone (irregular rectangles, grey-blue with buff and rust stones); coping = lighter square-cut stone; garden path + garden floor = blue-grey crushed stone / DG; walls = dry-stacked fieldstone with light caps; beds = brown bark mulch; play area = tan wood chips; synthetic lawn = artificial turf; front + side lawns = natural grass.
Walk and path outlines were generated as constant-width bands around hand-read centre lines (centre lines kept in attrs) and unioned with hand-traced landings; their edges are good to ~5 px.
